item.title: Brain dump after watching Classroom of the Elite Season 4 Episode 10
item.description:
I am a light novel reader for this series and this note includes a spoiler.

I watched the Classroom of the Elite, COTE, season 4, episode 9. First of all, this episode showed that Ayanokoji cannot become a weeb. That's most important thing in the episode.

Throughput this episode, it's good to see the animation of what's happening in this exam, especially it's hard to think what happens. Some history quiz or the anime quiz on the beginning is obvious, but the scene where Nanase took a rest was just on a few rocks without any water in a forest, for example. Why didn't find a place to drink water there. Also, it was great that Sudo didn't believe Nanase as he saw what she had done.

In the other scene, then Ayanokoji kissed Karuizawa. That scene doesn't show Ayanokoji's eyes at all so it's... scary what he thinks. Probably no face change, though, contrary to Karuizawa's blushed face.

What Nagumo did was something I didn't get and also forgot. He did something but... what was it in the LN?

item.title: Brain dump after watching Classroom of the Elite Season 4 Episode 9
item.description:
I am a light novel reader for this series and this note includes a spoiler.

I watched the Classroom of the Elite, COTE, season 4, episode 9. I may already remember scenes incorrectly throughout this series, or maybe an anime changed the original script. For example, there was a short scene of Nanase's past. How did Ayanokoji involve with someone outside of Whiteroom? Or maybe did this scene try to show Nanase was actually related to the Whiteroom? Also, somehow, Horikita knew that Ayanokoji and Kushida had a deal so he needs to give points. I remembered this was far later than this episode is, so I'm not really sure the intent is here.

As for the episode, at last, the new exam started. Tsukishiro's announcement that some amount of violences are allowed sounds really terrible here. And even no other teachers did not complaint or stop him, so that is very much like that school.

Then the island itself is very big and where Ayanokoji went in this episode is really in a jungle. It's really great way to show on the anime and it also shows that there is really a risk. A wrist for health checks and warnings really isn't enough in that size of the island honestly. I forgot how the island's exam when they were on the 1st year was, but now thinking about this exam, the jungle is so big and this exam looks so anime size. Well, cruise is also really big.

item.title: Brain dump after watching Oshi no Ko season 3 episode 11
item.description:
I am a manga reader for this series and this note includes a spoiler.

I watched the Oshi no Ko episode 11 on the season 3, as English Dub. The early part of this episode was something I really wanted to watch throughout this series, but I didn't expect there was a plot for Miyako in the season 3, too. The entire resolution between Ruby and Aqua was longer than the manga, or at least that's what I thought. The surprise and emotional talks and the animations of Ruby were worth, especially the setup before that scene increased the sympathy of her pain and grief. Honestly, she's so tough as she wa swamped and also shocked experiences. Watching Tendoji in anime was twice as bad as in the manga, and her husband not taking care of Sarina honestly were worse than her.

Then Miyako's scene. Miyako woar her high heel but she still caught up with Ichigo, so either she is super fast, or he is super slow. Christina, Miyako's voice actress, performed well on the scene when she yelled at Ichigo as the voice got low, angry, and realistic sound. After Ichigo came back to their office and Ruby knew Aqua did, she danced nowhere and that was happy and funny scene.

And I didn't expect the end of the series was the reaction from the claw girl after being asked if she can act or not. Btw, I don't remember her name, and this girl is actually really small when she stood by Aqua.

After watching this episode, I feel Aqua and the doctor, Goro, is really a cool guy. Considering to save many of his friends and took care of his patients. When I read a manga, it all made sense that he had a grief not to save Sarina, and wondered how hard it was as a doctor, even they are not special like Sarina for Goro.

Also, Akane noticed there was something missing in a script. Was there such a scene? I forgot. But she is so sharp as always because Kaburagi thought when he read the script it was something like vengeance or even more.

item.title: Watching Classroom of the Elite Season 4 Episode 7
item.description:
I am a light novel reader for this series and this note includes a spoiler.

I watched the Classroom of the Elite, COTE, season 4, episode 7. It was on the April til the episode 5, and on the episode 7, it got on July. I felt this season skipped a volume from the light novel, but I don't remember what it was even if it was.

Anyhow, in this episode, it's mostly about how 1st grade prepared next exam in an island. I think there were 2 main characters in this episode, Yagami and Housen, and they were contrary. Housen is obviously the main from the 1st year grade but Yagami also tried to group the 1st year together to fight against other years. At least from the acting and character design, he looks smart, kind, and thoughtful person.

The interesting character in the anime is Tsubaki. She was sucking her candy while Ayanokoji and a guy was talking, and suddenly she chewed it and the sound of chewing is loud enough while other 2 guys were talking. Probably going forward, she will always do the same thing as this is her character.

item.title: Watching Classroom of the Elite Season 4 Episode 6
item.description:
I am a light novel reader for this series and this note includes a spoiler.

This episode is whole about that preparation before that exam. Koenji may have a problem but he isn't worried at all and planned to do something. Ike had a crash on Shinohara but he couldn't ask her to join to a group on the next exam and she somehow joined with guys in the class B. Ike was actually pretty good at surviving in an island, which he showed in the last year, so that's why Ayanokoji cared him in this episode. Matsushita sneaked Ayanokoji and tried to ask him to be a group, too. This guy is smart and evaluates a person appropriately.

Interesting scene was Sakayanagi talked to Ichinose and Sakayanagi was surprised when Ichinose counter argued with Sakayanagi. She is excessively confident as she usually is, but also she underestimated Ichinose. Acting and animation of this Sakayanagi's reaction are better and bigger than I originally thought, maybe because of her confidence and her original prediction.

item.title: Watching Classroom of the Elite Season 4 Episode 4
item.description:
I am a light novel reader for this series

I watched the Classroom of the Elite, COTE, season 4, episode 4. This episode was one of the episodes I was waiting for in this season the most. Turned out that it was a little bit too fast after Ayanokoji found out what was Housen up to. I expected Horikita was more like in a panic when he got a knife in his left hand and also Sudo was almost shocked, and also they needed to take care of its bleeding. These entire reactions were removed and I felt they were too calm down even though they were just high school students in that school, except maybe Housen only. His reaction was good and maybe a director or producer thought that was enough? Also, I remembered he would say that he couldn't understand how Ayanokoji was so good before stabbing his knife, and that was one phrase I liked.

Besides, the exam showed that Ayanokoji's math score was 100 and better than anyone else, but there was no explanation how good it was, so the episode skipped a lot I felt.

Housen's fighting with Sudo and Horikita was kinda good, especially Horikita can actually fight and she could even do jump spinning kick. They still couldn't even have a chance against Housen, though. In this season, there will be more fighting scenes so maybe they'll be interested in.

item.title: Watching Classroom of the Elite Season 4 Episode 3
item.description:
I watched the Classroom of the Elite, COTE, season 4, episode 3. Karuizawa showed up at the first time in the season 4, and as she was bullied in a junior high school she was jealous maybe from anxiety and also head over kneels in love with Ayanokoji. Compared to her, he didn't change his face a bit even with her, though. Karuizawa even talked to Sato about the fact that they were dating and somehow Sato forgave Karuizawa right away. Sato was actually pretty good person without having jealous, but it was perhaps because he turned down Sato before already, so she knew there was no chance to date with him. I forgot why Sato started having a romantic feeling toward him, probably a sport festival in the 1st year, but maybe she actually has a good sense of seeing people through.

Also, Sakayanagi talked with Ayanokoji and tried to help him because she knew someone from Whiteroom came. It's cute that she was trying to help from the behind somehow.

Other than that, this episode was mostly like preparing what's going to happen next, with the discussion between Horikita's class and Housen's class in the next episode.

item.title: Watching Classroom of the Elite Season 4 Episode 2
item.description:
I watched the Classroom of the Elite, COTE, season 4, episode 2. In this episode, Horikita and Ayanokoji were trying to overcome the challenge on the next exam overall. Sakayanagi was also trying to do it by the information tactic by taking advantage of class A. What's funny was that compared to them, Ryuen and his classmates were only in a private Karaoke room and talked like he were a king, and ate a popcorn and drunk something like coke. If they're in a bar and drink a wine or wisky, maybe that matches with their characters. And I forgot how useful the 1st year will be through the end of the year and how much the assessment of Ryuen actually was useful.

Besides, Amasawa showed up at the first time in this episode, and she was really creepy woman. When I read the light novel, I guessed this girl was surely from the white room because it was so illogical of what she was doing, but also it might be just a confusing character for readers because Ayanokoji thought the same thing.

In the animation, I noticed the characters were drawn with intentional dashed or thin black lines. It is probably to avoid having clear boundaries of people by those lines because there are no such lines for real humans, but it gives me like an itchy feeling, because the line doesn't show clear distinction.

In the opening, in the previous episode, I guessed the noises on the eyes on each character might be whether they are candidates from Whiteroom or not, but in that case, Tsukishiro must not have it, and also, some 2nd year grades students also have the noises even those in the class D. Maybe these are just drawn on the scenes of Ayanokoji's views and he views most people with that view regardless of a student from the Whiteroom or not.

Ending is, what the heck. Classroom leaders do not matter in the ending, characters are from 1st year and 2nd year, and Ayanokoji is on a throne. Then there is a snake, venomous snake, I guess, and all got dead without any flesh by that venom. No idea what it meant, though. The king Ayanokoji himself is venomous and will kill everybody? Another possibility is that there is a student from the Whiteroom, but they have nothing to do with anyone but Ayanokoji.

item.title: Watching Classroom of the Elite Season 4 Episode 1
item.description:
I watched the Classroom of the Elite, COTE, season 4, episode 1. I read the light novel in 2nd year's arc.

I don't remember in the previous seasons that much, but I felt strange to hear the voice of Chabashira, and a little bit about Ikeda. It looks like Chabashira's voice actress is Jennifer Alyx, and seems hasn't been changed since season 1 so I'll get used to it.

Throughout the entire episode, it's funny to see the Housen and it's character design, considering that he is 15 or 16 years old, perhaps, as the 1st year in the high school, but he is matured in the anime level. When Ryuen just came to Housen and was trying to leave there without not doing anything was more like scenario-based story, so that the sole purpose is to show the relationship between Ryuen and Housen and how Housen is intimidating. Ryuen and Sakayanagi often do these things so I shouldn't care those things that much, though.

The ending of this season is good for both of animation and song. What the noises of eyes on each character mean? Some characters do not have like leaders in each class in the 2nd year, but many of others have. Maybe those are candidates from the whiteroom in Kiyotaka's mind. Need to double check the animation.

item.title: Watching Oshi no Ko season 3 episode 10
item.description:
I watched the Oshi no Ko episode 10 on the season 3. It was about the self audition of Ruby, and a little bit about the past of her, or rather, Sarina. This was kinda sudden because what she thought in these days are more for vengeance and nothing else.

But as a manga reader, this episode gave me a dry laugh about how Akane, Aqua, and even Kaburagi thought. Akane was trying to stop Aqua because he was trying to do something and she was resolved by any means, and he was responding that he would do anything. Kaburagi thought the movie might be beyond the vengeance from Aqua. And then Aqua behaves like he would string Kana by how he wanted. Well, we'll see what's going to be on season 4, but at least Akane and Aqua sound like they would fight in a Shonen world.

And again, how could Akane guessed the audition and the movie was from Aqua and how could she know what he planned? She dated with him before this movie planned not after, and even if she happens to know, there is no way that the audition from Fril liar's performance was about that movie.

Good animation and scene in this episode was, though, Akane felt awkward to talk with Ruby for acting and Ruby treated her as if she was Ruby's sister. Akane isn't extravert so this matches with her character, and Ruby also thought the same thing in the previous episode, so this was kinda good and funny scene.

item.title: Watching Oshi no Ko season 3 episode 9
item.description:
I watched the Oshi no Ko episode 9 on the season 3. I don't remember these stories that much from manga.

The first scene is mainly about how the production of a Japanese movie is and shows how Gotanda and Kaburagi did for a Gotanda's movie. It showed how hard the producer needs to work on his job for networking with actors and actresses to name them on the best TV shows or movies. From the Gotanda's PoV, Kaburagi actually has a passion instead of "pecunia maniac" which he says he is. When he looks back frmo the window of a room in a building, he looks cool rather than he is just a mob in the past episodes.

Then Kana and Aqua finally started talking instead of he avoids her. She put up with her feeling for a long time and now she knew she didn't have to because he broke up with Akane, but she made a mistake that she told him she wasn't going to date with him. She was happy now and Memcho was happy to see her like that. But Memcho is now worrying about Akane and because the most low cost animated character in this episode.

At the end of the episode, Ruby and Fril started to have a private audition with Akane. Fril apparantly knows what she is doing, and shwoed how professional she is. Her acting was so good that she started crying when she was just turning around, and her voice actress also changed her acting during her self audition. I think this is the first episode for how good her acting is, though throughput this series, they kept saying she was a top talent. In anime, there are many characters like her, but voice actors or actresses have to perform like they are top talents so producers are hard in those anime, I guess. Or from Kaburagi's words, they don't have to be if it succeeds commercially. Well, maybe it was same thing for Ai, Kana and Akane, though.

item.title: Watching Oshi no Ko season 3 episode 8
item.description:
I watched the Oshi no Ko episode 8 on the season 3. Ruby obviously got angry with Aqua and got mad at him because he tipped off at Ai. While she was pushing him to the wall, her white star became a black star on her left eye. In the last episode, the white star was on her right eye. I didn't get why the eye was changed from the right to the left in this episode, but at least changing from white to black seemed to show that she was disappointed with Aqua or anyone and resolved more revenge.

For the rest of this entire episode was almost about the new film the Director Gotanda made. Ai affected so many people surrounding her even him and made a script for that, and then Kaburagi decided to make it. I wasn't sure how Kaburagi decided casts, though. From an watcher's perspective, it's obvious, but if I would need to think logically, B-komachi is the one for B-komachi's casts, Akane and Frill are those for talented idols, Aqua is obvious. I don't know Melt and Yura. It needs a capability to accept something dark and made it and he said he is the only one who can make but forgot why he thinks that way. What was his past?

item.title: Watching Oshi no Ko season 3 episode 7
item.description:
I watched the Oshi no Ko episode 7 on the season 3, and here is the thoughts after I watched the episode including spoilers. This episode was how to deal with a gossip before it's released to the public, and the scene It's interesting how Memcho emphasized with Kana and cried together while Ruby was just looking at them without hugging together. She had been that kind of a person but she was not anymore. However, while talking with Aqua, the white star in a her eye was back, at least only in her right eye. That was a great animation and showed how genuinely she truly cared them.

On the other hand, when Aqua talked to the writer and tried to share his secret, animation uses the dark, foggy, cloudy background with a high-pitched, creepy sound like a horror. Then after talking with Akane, the black stars in his eyes were back and that feels power and explosion of a power.

This and the scene with Akane was one of the scene I wanted to watch in Anime at most. I don't write about how the scene is. It was a great one and I waited for this. Aside from the scene, it was funny that Aqua was always ready to save Akane like this time while he was chasing her and still was able to hide from her all the time.

item.title: Watching Oshi no Ko season 3 episode 6
item.description:
Episode 6 was about mainly about an entertainment industry in Japan and Kana. In the last episode, Kana went to a director's office and a journalist took her photo for a gossip. This episode was all about how a male idol meeting with a woman or a female idol meeting with a man and someone got known to that. On the earlier part, Ruby was really not interested with a romantic relationship and thought SNS changed an idol who actually had a romantic relationship started not coming under fire. However, in the later of this episode, Kana thought about how an idol dooms when they have a hidden romantic relationship and someone expose it, and they get flammed, which was actually the old thing from what Ruby thought. Kana has seen the old days of the industry because she has worked since she was a child, and also it was now her turn to come under fire, so she thought what would come from a negative side. I felt a little bit weird that she was so gloomy and naive.... but well, actually, she is naive person.

Also, compared to manga, this scene was over dramatized, apparently. If I remember correctly, these episodes were also flammed in the SNS on the manga, so anime production may try to make watchers sympathize more, or at least that's what I felt.

item.title: Watching Oshi no Ko season 3 episode 5
item.description:
Episode 5 was about mainly about Akane and Kana. I'm a manga reader and remember vaguely about the contents of this episode, but it seems it's so different from the manga in this. Akane's PoV was from the previous episode and she became a FBI in this episode. There was also a scene to call Aqua while she was wearing a pajama with her pigtail hair. It was rare that Aqua showed his weakness to her and also tried to be addicted, but I forgot this was a performance or from the bottom of his heart. But she showed genuinely how much she cares with their relationship and she has such a big heart with a big love.

Miyako and the assisstant director of Ruby talked about how much Japanese idols do not have human rights. They were so funny to talk about the every single details of how bad they are. That said, it was strange or creepy to see how Ruby reacted like she had used to be before she decided to take a revenge. It's animated for comedy scenes, and instead of realistic and gorgeous animation, it's more like soft, symbolic, and 2D animation.

With Kana's scene, it was perhaps different from a manga. I thought it was only one day instead of multiple days, and then went to an office of the director. When Kana rememberd Aqua by looking at jellyfish, they were totally different and suddenly changed the form from there to eventualy Aqua, and it was so weird and feeling she imagined too much to me. But comes to think about his name, this animation is with a creativity, I guess. She met the director to get a job, but it shows she cares more to the relationship with Aqua than getting a big job. Now I'm trying to remember who she is. She was a genius child actress but Akane, Ruby, and maybe more appeared and they get more jobs than her, so she lost confidence and be more cynical and flexible to get her job. So this might be rare to turn down her job there.

item.title: Watching Oshi no Ko season 3 episode 4
item.description: Episode 4 moves a lot of story points. Maybe one of the most important episodes since season 1. I read a manga for this, but it's great how Ruby didn't feel anything about manipulating other people and talk with her smile and joy about how she behaved badly to others. Also, on the anime, it's great expressions and voice performance to see how Aqua was disappointed and went to gloomy when he was all wrong. He was all emotional and even his alter ego blamed him in his mind. It's kinda pitty but this really gives me how he wants to live for himself. And then, Akane. I didn't remember in the manga how Akane figured out Kamiki, but this episode on to that scene, too. Unlike Ruby's black star on her eyes, Akane has yellow star on her eyes and they also lightened up when she got a new actress award and she found out the Kamiki. It shows how Akane wants to help Aqua here as his girlfriend. That's a good comparison. Anyway, she should go into a police officer or FBI. Kana, on the other hand, also wants to help him as she was fallen in a love with him while he was just sitting on a bench but he made his head down. But Aqua rejected because he was in his own world at that time, and he was so shocked that he couldn't chase her nor he couldn't care her. For an half year to enjoy his own life with Akane really makes him peaceful, appearantly.
